ValidationRule.description: 16/10/2026: Lead tao qua API phai co so dien thoai hop le: chi chu so, co the co dau + o dau, dai 9-15 so (nhan ca so nuoc ngoai). Khoang trang/dau gach/dau cham/ngoac da duoc APICreateLead xoa truoc khi insert.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), isAPI__c, OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(MobilePhone)), NOT(REGEX(MobilePhone, "^\\+?[0-9]{9,15}$"))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Mobile_check__c)), NOT(REGEX(Mobile_check__c, "^\\+?[0-9]{9,15}$"))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Field: Mobile is invalid (digits only, optional leading +, 9-15 digits)
